name: schemaemitter-repeat-key
body: Emission.EmitFile detects a repeated declaration on the joined Schema.Name text, case-insensitively, so dotted bracketed names such as [a.b].c and a.[b.c] count as one identity (both render the same FQN, so the later one is dropped either way, with a repeat rather than a collision diagnostic); and it records an object as its scope's first declaration before the FQN-collision check, so a later repeat of an object that was itself dropped as a collision names the dropped declaration in its diagnostic. Upgrade to a (schema, name) key and record firsts only for emitted objects if either diagnostic must be exact.
